Solution: Both parts of 3/5 are positive, and its numerator is smaller than its denominator. Therefore 0 < 3/5 < 1. It lies between 0 and 1: choice A.

Hints: Warmer means a greater signed temperature, farther right on the number line.

Solution: -30 < -28. Diver A is at the lower signed position and is deeper.
